skills.name: lambda-standards
skills.description: Runtime rules for Node.js/TypeScript AWS Lambda functions — handler as composition root, module-scope SDK clients, env validation, idempotency for retried SQS/EventBridge events, partial batch failures, timeouts, memory and structured logging. Use when writing or reviewing a Lambda handler or event consumer, or when asked about "cold starts", "lambda timeout", "retries" or "duplicate events".
